name: Speech Commands: Keyword Spotting Dataset
description: The Speech Commands dataset consists of 105,829 one-second audio recordings of 35 words spoken by 2,618 different speakers. Created by Google Brain to provide a standard benchmark for small-footprint keyword spotting and limited-vocabulary voice interface models.
